metadata.short_desc: Local-first long-term memory: remembers, writes a diary, sees pictures, knows what it can do
metadata.desc: Long-term memory that moves with the character (memory-core library): every message is an episode, consolidated into memories with sources; visibility per chat; a daily diary and self-image; fading, merging and hard forgetting; seeing pictures; a list of what it can do. A memory dashboard in the plugin views.
